|Never! States our law. Never must our melody pass to a bug not Keeper! But you, fool Weaver, would shatter those tenants with reckless ease.
|[[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]]}}

<b>Psalm Cylinders</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are metallic cylinders found throughout [[the Citadel]] inscribed with recordings that can be heard by bringing them to [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]]. 

The <b>Sacred Cylinder</b> is a unique cylinder that is apart of the <i>[[LEARN: Vaultkeeper's Melody]]</i> objective, that will teach [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] the [[Vaultkeeper's Melody]].


== Use ==
Can be sold to [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]] for {{R|200}}, or {{R|320}} for the Sacred Cylinder, which is also required to learn the [[Vaultkeeper's Melody]], and complete the wish.

The recordings on the Cylinders can be listened to after selling them by visiting Vaultkeeper Cardinius. After all Psalm Cylinders have been sold to Vaultkeeper Cardinius, and the [[Desk]] has been purchased, the [[Gramophone]] may be purchased from [[Frey]] and installed in the [[Bellhome]]. The Cylinders can then be listened to from the [[Desk]].

==Trivia==
* The Cylinders took inspiration from the [[Wikipedia:phonograph cylinder|phonograph cylinder]]s, the earliest medium to record and replay sounds in real life.
**They also resemble [[Wikipedia:music box|music box]] cylinders, as pegs are visible on the cylinder's surface.
* The Cylinders described as guide tracks for the choir with themes of ascendence and salvation feature music box orchestrations of the [[Soundtrack (Silksong)|music]] to [[High Halls]] and [[Choral Chambers]], respectively.
